name: UFO abduction
summary: A rare night-time UFO encounter on a Kelly County road that ends in an abduction and unlocks The Truth Is Out There.
body: PowerPyx says the UFO appears on the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County at night after 2:00 AM, only when the player is alone, and that the spawn is random.
PowerPyx says the sign is a car with blinking lights at the roadside; if it is missing, drive away and come back.
According to PowerPyx, a path beside the car leads into the woods to a bright blue light in the sky, where the UFO drops a woman it had taken.
PowerPyx says agreeing to help her and walking back to her car brings the UFO back to take the player, who wakes three days later in the morning.
PowerPyx says the encounter unlocks The Truth Is Out There trophy or achievement.

name: Looting police cars
summary: Parked police cars can be opened with the Slim Jim and their trunks searched for guns, ammo, armor and cash.
body: Sportskeeda says the Slim Jim, given in a Chapter 2 story mission, opens the driver's door of a parked police car.
Sportskeeda says sitting inside switches off the trunk alarm, so the trunk can then be opened without setting it off.
Sportskeeda reports finding assault rifles and once a shotgun, ammunition in a storage crate, a stun gun, and sometimes money and body armor.
PC Gamer says police pickups such as the Bravado Bison have a storage crate in the bed that can be opened without any alarm, and may hold weapons, ammo and stun guns.

PC Gamer says a cruiser's trunk is alarmed, but breaking into the car with the slim jim from the Chapter 2 mission Moses unlocks the trunk, which often holds an assault rifle, a shotgun or body armour; without the slim jim a screwdriver opens it and sets off the alarm.
